options_evaluated: Die-cast aluminum alloy with mechanical fasteners
assessments.recommendation: Die-cast aluminum alloy with mechanical fasteners
assessments.rationale: Die-cast aluminum provides superior durability and reliability (a) [Page 79] by resisting mechanical stresses and ageing during service, preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27]. Using mechanical fasteners instead of overmolding ensures ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by allowing easy disassembly using commonly available tools [Page 8]. Additionally, it eliminates the release of microplastics and nanoplastics (p) [Page 80] that occurs when overmolded polymer grips wear down during use, and maintains functional performance (s) [Page 80] throughout its technical lifetime.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to the higher initial carbon footprint, material consumption, and weight of aluminum compared to lightweight plastics, which conflicts with lightweight design goals.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal fasteners (screws) with threaded brass inserts
assessments.recommendation: Threaded metal fasteners (screws) with threaded brass inserts
assessments.rationale: Threaded metal fasteners directly support ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by enabling non-destructive disassembly and reassembly with commonly available tools [Page 8]. This prevents premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] and ensures durability and reliability (a) [Page 79] over multiple repair cycles. It also avoids generating plastic waste (r) [Page 80] from broken snap-fit joints or permanently bonded housings that must be discarded when internal components fail.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, as it increases the number of parts, assembly complexity, and production costs compared to quick snap-fits or ultrasonic welding.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital controller
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital controller
assessments.rationale: A brushless motor significantly enhances durability and reliability (a) [Page 79] by eliminating wearing carbon brushes, thereby extending the technical lifetime and mean time between failures. It optimizes the use and consumption of energy (g) [Page 79] during service, aligning with energy efficiency goals to reduce the product's energy footprint [Page 3]. It also improves functional performance (s) [Page 80] and reduces noise emissions (q) [Page 80] during operation.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to the use of critical raw materials (magnets) and complex electronics, which increases the initial material footprint and cost.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heatsink and ventilation slots
Active cooling with miniature electric fan
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heatsink and ventilation slots
assessments.rationale: Passive cooling maximizes reliability and durability (a) [Page 79] because it has no moving parts that can fail, preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27]. It consumes no additional energy (g) [Page 79] during operation, generates no extra noise emissions (q) [Page 80], and requires zero maintenance (b) [Page 79] compared to active fans that accumulate dust and block airflow.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design and Manufacturing stages, as passive heatsinks increase the physical size and weight of the tool, and may limit peak functional performance (s) under prolonged heavy duty cycle conditions due to slower heat dissipation compared to active cooling.

options_evaluated: Modular design with separate, easily swappable modules (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular design with separate, easily swappable modules (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
assessments.rationale: A fully modular architecture directly addresses ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by allowing individual faulty components to be replaced without replacing the entire tool. This extends the product's technical lifetime (a) [Page 79], ensures the availability and accessibility of spare parts (l) [Page 79], and minimizes the amount of waste generated (r) [Page 80] during the service phase.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, as modular connectors and housing partitions increase the product's volume, weight, and initial manufacturing complexity and cost.

options_evaluated: Removable and interchangeable slide-on Li-ion battery pack with standard interface
assessments.recommendation: Removable and interchangeable slide-on Li-ion battery pack with standard interface
assessments.rationale: For a cordless screwdriver, a removable and interchangeable battery pack is essential to prevent premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] when the battery cells degrade. This choice ensures ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] and the availability and accessibility of consumables and spare parts (l) [Page 79]. It allows users to maintain functional performance (s) [Page 80] and significantly reduces the amount of hazardous waste generated (r) [Page 80] by avoiding discarding the entire tool when only the battery fails.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design stage, as a standardized slide-on battery interface increases the tool's handle dimensions, weight, and compromises compact ergonomic styling.
